knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(MODISTools)
library(dplyr)

estaciones <- data.frame(
  site_name = c("NE2", "NE3"),
  lat = c(25.77722, 25.79056),
  lon = c(-100.18806, -100.07833)
)

evi_raw <- mt_batch_subset(
  df = estaciones,
  product = "MOD13Q1",
  band = "250m_16_days_EVI",
  start = "2021-01-01",
  end = "2025-12-31",
  km_lr = 0,
  km_ab = 0
)
```

```{r}
names(evi_raw)
```
```{r}
unique(evi_raw$site)
```

```{r}
summary(evi_raw$value)
```

```{r}
table(evi_raw$site)
```

```{r}
head(evi_raw$calendar_date)
```

```{r}
df_evi <- evi_raw %>%
  mutate(EVI = value * 0.0001) %>%
  select(
    estacion = site,
    fecha = calendar_date,
    EVI
  )

head(df_evi)$
```



```{r}
write.csv(df_evi, "EVI_estaciones.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}
evi_ne2 <- df_evi %>%
  filter(estacion == "NE2")

evi_ne3 <- df_evi %>%
  filter(estacion == "NE3")
```

```{r}
nrow(evi_ne2)
nrow(evi_ne3)
```

```{r}
write.csv(evi_ne2, "EVI_NE2.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(evi_ne3, "EVI_NE3.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
